calls.event: 3rd Largest Company end of November 2026?

calls.question: Will Microsoft be the third-largest company in the world by market cap on November 30, 2026?

calls.event: Brentford FC vs. Everton FC
calls.method: Poisson attack/defence strength, 120-match half-life, fitted per league; draw counts as NO. Measured on 17,269 matches: our Brier 0.5892 vs bookmaker 0.5719 — this model LOSES to the closing line by 0.017 and is published with that score visible. It beats a constant 45/26/29 guess (0.6484) and is closer than the book on 44.4% of matches.
calls.question: Will Brentford FC win on 2026-11-23?
